evidence: Characterization of prior autoscaling work, appropriately hedged as a 'reasonable proxy'. For a single-stage, text-only service the whole fleet is fed by one request/token stream, so aggregate request rate or utilization is a standard and reasonable demand signal (established autoscaling practice: request rate co-moves with the one pool's load when there is only one homogeneous pool). The claim asserts adequacy only in the single-pool text case, and the thesis's contrast (multi-pool modality-disaggregated case, where the same signal fails) is exactly what makes the scoped 'reasonable proxy' correct rather than overclaimed.
fix: None needed; hedge ('reasonable proxy') is appropriate.
